_help: The NPC dialogue window (UI/UIWindow2.img/UtilDlgEx): the box is the official 519-wide art. leftTop = where the visible grey NPC column starts below the top piece. npcPortraitX = the centre of its stand art; namePlateX = the left edge of the grey 109x19 name plate and nameGap is the gap above it. textDx/textDy = the first text line fallback; textW = how wide the text may be, lineStep = one line; the line/entry block is left-aligned and vertically centred in the white area. entryDx/entryW = a quest entry row; it must equal textDx so black and blue text share one left edge. minH = the smallest box height; btnY = END CHAT's distance above the bottom (it centres in the blue bar). whiteTop/whiteRight/whiteBottom = the white area's top/right/bottom edge; leftBottom = the lower edge that centres the portrait and name plate in the grey column; actionBottom/actionY/actionRight/actionGap = PREV/NEXT and Yes/No inside that white area's bottom-right; endX = END CHAT's left inset. centerY = the middle of the screen where the box sits.
